content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the ECHS recruitment is 14th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive offers vacancies for three distinct posts: Officer-in-Charge, Medical Officer, and Dental A/T/H. Each post has specific eligibility criteria and responsibilities.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ECHS?
faq.answer: The Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the Officer-in-Charge, Medical Officer, and Dental A/T/H positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates varies by post. Officer-in-Charge and Medical Officer posts offer a salary of Rs. 95,000/- per month, while the Dental A/T/H post offers Rs. 36,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Medical Officer post, candidates must have an MBBS degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience after internship. Additional qualifications in medicine or surgery are preferable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this ECHS recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidates be selected for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ECHS recruitment will primarily involve an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for the positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this ECHS recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ECHS recruitment located?
faq.answer: The ECHS recruitment is for positions located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 211001. Candidates should ensure they are willing to work in this location.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job offered by ECHS?
faq.answer: The recruitment by Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) is for contractual positions. This means the selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for a specified period.
